note: Set B correctly binds the Laundry Millwork section dimensions (2' - 5 1/16" width, 7' - 0 1/8" height) to the A6 laundry millwork, facts Set A omits entirely. Set A instead repeats the platform height and the 8' - 4" width under two different names, invents the condition "to counter top" for a 3' - 0" height, and includes an MWB02 claim whose quote is a garbled fragment. Set B's main faults are spurious "inches" units attached to two material values and a few vague entities, but it is cleaner and better bound overall.
remarks: Both sets miss the 6 1/2", 2' - 0" and 8" dimensions visible in the text layer, and neither captures the 3' - 3 3/4" pair in the North Island elevation as clearly as it appears (Set A states it once, vaguely). The MWB02 quote in Set A ('MWB02 CTION CENTER MODU') is a text-layer/OCR merge of the A1/A3 'CENTER MODULE MILLWORK SECTION' title with the MWB02 mark, so that claim cannot be verified from the quote. Several 3' - 0" and 5" values appear multiple times on the sheet with no unambiguous component binding in the text layer, so both sets' assignments of those values are partly guesswork.
